label: Some actual concrete being exists only at worlds with the actual handedness
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: a chiral individual. Some concrete being x exists at w, and at every world where x exists the feature H (global handedness) has its value at w. Example: an actual molecule of one enantiomer, if being of its chemical kind is essential to it and the mirror image of that molecule is a molecule of the other kind (sortal essentialism with enantiomers as distinct kinds). A haecceitist who holds that the same molecule exists, mirrored, at the mirror image denies it.
